clauses.reason: A rerun of the same workspace-sync is the recovery for a lost trailer; a merge without a sync record stays unverified.

updates.rationale: The sync record already binds the authorized before tip and source; recognizing a merge only through a rerun of that same sync keeps manual merges and copied trailers unverified while removing the need to rewrite history.
updates.statement: A member is synchronized only by a maintenance workspace-sync merge carrying the machine-local sync record and its Signetum-Sync trailer, from the delivery branch, a batch or, for a stacked member, its parent. A conflicted sync is committed with git commit --no-edit to keep the trailer; when the trailer was lost, rerunning maintenance workspace-sync with the same source records a recognition of that exact merge, which then stands in for the trailer. The ratchet baseline is the latest such source, otherwise the recorded base. A failed ratchet lists unrecorded first-parent merges and names maintenance workspace-sync and maintenance workspace-sync --batch as the recovery.

decisions.reason: Git pre-fills the sync trailer in a conflicted merge, but an edited commit message dropped it and left no recovery short of rewriting history. The machine-local sync record already proves that workspace-sync authorized exactly that before tip and source, so rerunning the same sync can bind it to the merge without trusting a copied trailer or a manual merge.
